content: Why Hillary Clinton and her rivals are struggling to grasp Black Lives Matter

blurb: Democratic presidential candidate Hillary Rodham Clinton speaks at a campaign event in New York. Clinton’s campaign appears to be closely following Black Lives Matter, activists said. (Seth Wenig/AP)
fullcaption: Democratic presidential candidate Hillary Rodham Clinton speaks at a campaign event in New York. Clinton’s campaign appears to be closely following Black Lives Matter, activists said. (Seth Wenig/AP)

content: By Wesley Lowery and David Weigel

Amid the famous politicians, wealthy donors and top Democratic Party officials invited to New York last month to watch Hillary Rodham Clinton announce her candidacy for president sat another VIP guest — a newcomer to politics, but a man whose presence at the event was sought after by Clinton aides.

title: Protesters disrupt O'Malley, Sanders
blurb: Activists from Black Lives Matter and other groups interrupted Democratic presidential candidates Bernie Sanders and Martin O'Malley during a Netroots Nation event in Phoenix.

bio: Wesley Lowery is a national reporter covering law enforcement and justice for the Washington Post. He previously covered Congress and national politics.

title: Mourning and questioning after Chattanooga rampage
blurb: Investigators probe for a motive behind Mohammad Youssef Abdulazeez’s shooting spree that left four Marines and a Navy officer dead in Tennessee.
